name: What is a sheer descent waterfall?

mainEntity.name: What is a sheer descent waterfall?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sheer descent waterfall is a type of water feature characterized by a continuous, smooth sheet of water flowing from a horizontal scupper or spillway into a pool or basin. It creates a modern, elegant aesthetic and a tranquil sound. These features are often integrated into retaining walls, raised spas, or custom-built structures in pools and landscapes.
acceptedAnswer.description: A sheer descent waterfall is a water feature that creates a smooth, continuous sheet of water flowing from a horizontal spillway.
